GSSSB Work Assistant Recruitment 2026: 1,663 Vacancies, Online Applications Close October 29

Background And Context

The supplied source did not provide broader background beyond the recruitment details. It focused on the Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board, or GSSSB, and the Work Assistant Class 3 notification.

Confirmed Details

The source stated that the online application process for Work Assistant Class 3 vacancies was to close on October 29, 2026. The application window started on October 15, 2026, according to the source. The recruitment notice was Advertisement No. 461/2026-27. The source listed 1,663 total vacancies. The last date to apply online was October 29, 2026, until 11:59 PM. The fee payment deadline was November 1, 2026. The source listed a fixed salary of Rs 26,000 per month for the first five years. The age limit was 18 to 33 years as of October 29, 2026.

Eligibility And Fees

The source said candidates needed a Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution or an equivalent qualification approved by the concerned department. It mentioned equivalent diplomas including Civil Construction, Civil Environmental Engineering and Construction Technology. It said candidates with a Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering were not eligible. Basic computer knowledge and working knowledge of Gujarati, Hindi or both were required. Age relaxation was mentioned for reserved category candidates, women, persons with disabilities and ex-servicemen as per the notification.

The source listed an examination fee of Rs 500 for the unreserved category and Rs 400 for reserved categories, women and eligible other categories. It said the fee would be refunded to candidates who appeared for the examination, and no refund would be given to those who did not appear.

Application Process

The source described applying through the official OJAS Gujarat website at ojas.gujarat.gov.in. It said candidates could use the Current Advertisement Section link titled GSSSB Work Assistant, Class 3, then Apply Now, log in with required OTR registration details, enter personal and educational details, provide bank account information, pay the fee, review the form and save the confirmation page.

Uncertainties And Verification

The source did not fully resolve all procedural questions. It did not clearly state whether the portal remained open at the time of writing, and it did not detail every eligibility exemption. The final authority for recruitment details is the official source. Readers should check official channels.

Practical Implications

The deadlines are important: online application by October 29, 2026, and fee payment by November 1, 2026. Candidates should confirm eligibility before applying, especially because the source said a Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering was not eligible while a Diploma in Civil Engineering was required. The salary figure and age limit should also be checked against the official notification.

What Is Confirmed Versus Unknown

Confirmed in the supplied source are the recruitment organisation, post name, advertisement number, total vacancies, application mode, application start date, last date, fee payment deadline, age limit, salary and eligibility details. Unknown or requiring official confirmation are changes to dates, portal status, specific age relaxation calculations and final eligibility outcomes.

Impact On Candidates

For candidates, the deadline means they must complete online application and fee payment within the stated periods. The source asked candidates to check eligibility, fees and other details before submitting the form. The source also said the fee would be refunded to candidates who appeared for the examination, while no refund would be given to absent candidates who did not appear.

How To Verify

Readers can check the original announcement through the Jagran Josh source link and the official OJAS and GSSSB websites. The final decision on any recruitment detail should come from the official notification.

How Readers Can Check The Original Announcement
